summary: The client side of HTTP is covered by URLSession in the SDK, which streams and caches responses, and by the shell's rustls HTTP/1.1 client. The Apple CFHost, CFNetService (Bonjour), proxy, diagnostics, FTP and raw stream APIs have no app-facing counterpart. Network state and DHCP are owned by the system network service, which apps cannot query through an SDK API.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. URLRequest carries URL, method, body and headers. There is no raw serialized HTTP message, no response status line access and no CFHTTPMessageAppendBytes equivalent.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLSession::bytes, 301/302/303/307/308 followed up to 5 hops); springboard/src/deildu/http.rs (keep-alive, redirects)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Streaming and redirects work. Persistent connections are reused, but no HTTP/2, no stream properties and no final-URL property are exposed.

features.apple: Cookie storage through CFNetwork and the HTTP stream session (CFHTTPMessage headers; Apple doc mentions no separate cookie API in this framework)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (w3-cfnetwork, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The SDK URLSession keeps no cookies. Only the Deildu client keeps its own jar; apps get none.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Wave 3 (w3-cfnetwork, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No credentials type and no challenge handling for apps. Decided in docs/bifrost-ui.md section URLSession as a gap (no URLCredential).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-cfnetwork, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The resolver exists inside the shell's HTTP client. Apps have no name lookup API.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No proxy settings are read or applied. The Network settings page shows Ethernet, Wi-Fi and a Network Manager row only.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 5 (w5-cfnetwork, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No service discovery or registration API for apps. The shell has no mDNS browser exposed in the SDK.

features.feature: Network configuration, link state and DHCP
features.apple: Network configuration and reachability through SystemConfiguration and CFHostGetReachability (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/cfnetwork/hosts)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/reachability.rs (has_default_route, probe, classify); springboard/sdk/src/network_path.rs (Path, Status); springboard/netd (Wi-Fi, DHCP, routes behind a socket); springboard/src/net/wifi.rs (Status, sysfs link state); springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (is.olibuijr.net service protocol)
features.note: Apps get a default-route check, a TCP reachability probe and the connectivity path, with tests for the route check and the error decoding. The system still owns Wi-Fi, DHCP and routes, and apps cannot configure them.
The PC has no cellular interface. Service type hints have no counterpart on Linux, and no SDK API exposes them.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/deildu/http.rs (Tls wraps rustls with the webpki roots)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. TLS certificate validation is on, using the webpki roots, for the HTTP client. No per-stream SSL settings, no client identities and no SOCKS.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 5 (w5-cfnetwork, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No diagnostic window or API. The Wi-Fi page shows link state only.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 6 (b16, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. FTP is not implemented in the SDK. Low priority for a desktop with a file portal. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Errors are returned as Rust results with the transport message. There is no CFNetworkErrors code mapping.

gaps: No cookie storage or URLCredential/HTTP authentication for URLSession apps (springboard/sdk/src/url.rs)
No host name lookup API for apps (CFHost); the resolver stays inside springboard/src/deildu/http.rs
No proxy configuration read or applied (CFNetworkCopySystemProxySettings)
No Bonjour or network service browse and register API (CFNetService)
No app-facing reachability or connectivity API; springboard/src/net/ntp.rs and springboard/src/net/wifi.rs use it internally only
No network diagnostics window or API (CFNetDiagnostic)
No raw HTTP message API (CFHTTPMessage) and no HTTP/2
